name: Bento Grid
description: Responsive 3-column asymmetric layout grid for high-impact feature displays.
summary: An asymmetric modular layout grid inspired by Japanese bento box architecture and modern product showcase decks. Utilizes a responsive 3-column CSS Grid system (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) with configurable colSpan props on child BentoCard containers (1, 2, or 3 columns). Accommodates visual graphic headers, accent iconography, and typography with smooth 300ms hover border brightening.
highlights: Asymmetric 3-column CSS Grid with automatic single-column mobile collapse
Configurable colSpan spans (col-span-1, col-span-2, col-span-3) on desktop
Compound component pattern (BentoGrid + BentoCard) with type-safe interfaces
Subtle hover border brightening and background tinting with 300ms transition
Header viewport slot accommodating interactive previews, charts, and media
anatomy: <BentoGrid> (CSS Grid container with 16px gap spacing and max-w-7xl auto centering)
<BentoCard> (Flex container card with customizable colSpan, border, and background)
<div> (Header Slot: optional top container for diagrams, screenshots, or code previews)
<div> (Icon + Title: flex row with hover color transitions and font-semibold styling)
(Description: light zinc-400 typography with relaxed leading for high readability)

physics.description: Zero-overhead responsive CSS Grid with CSS transition-all hover state transitions.

parameters.label: Border Transition
parameters.value: zinc-200/80 to zinc-300 (light), zinc-800/80 to zinc-700 (dark)

accessibility.aria: BentoGrid renders a plain div with no role. Pass role and aria-labelledby through props when the grid forms a labelled section.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No reduced-motion handling. The 300ms hover transitions always run.

keyboard.description: Standard keyboard tab navigation passes cleanly to interactive items inside cards.

recommended: Product feature comparison sections on SaaS landing pages
Architecture overview matrices and capability grids
Design system component galleries and capability highlights
bestPractices: Group cards in complementary row sums that total 3 columns (e.g. 2 + 1, 1 + 1 + 1, or 3)
Place the most visually complex card with an interactive header in a 2-colSpan slot
Use subtle borders and deep zinc backgrounds (#0c0c0e or zinc-950) to retain clean contrast

props.name: colSpan
props.description: Number of grid columns spanned by BentoCard on medium and larger viewports (md:col-span-1, md:col-span-2, or md:col-span-3).

props.name: title
props.description: Feature headline displayed on the BentoCard.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary explanatory paragraph detailing feature value and capabilities.

props.name: header
props.description: Visual graphic, preview element, screenshot, or interactive canvas rendered above card content.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon element displayed beside the card title with hover color transitions.

props.name: children
props.description: Child BentoCard elements or custom elements rendered inside BentoGrid.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS utility classes passed to BentoGrid or BentoCard.
